name: customer-support
title: Customer Support Bot

origin.source: LangGraph customer-support (airline assistant) tutorial, Part 3 (conditional interrupt)

comparison.purpose: LangGraph gates sensitive tools with interrupt_before=["sensitive_tools"] and resumes by re-invoking (None to approve, a synthetic ToolMessage to deny). Here the pause is a first-class idle `confirming` state (tags awaiting-approval, typed meta.interaction, pendingAction in context): runAgent settles { status: 'idle', snapshot }, the host persists it, and a second runAgent call resumes with an APPROVE or DENY event. Safe Q&A is one request with real read-only tools; a structured-output classify request routes safe vs sensitive.
